calibration_description: Empirical, profile-balanced 90th percentile of standardized positive residuals on separate calibration profiles. Not a profile-level coverage guarantee.
architecture: 49 inputs / Dense(96) / ReLU / Dense(64) / ReLU / Dense(4). First-order causal history filters.
limitations: Data faults are injected, not physical motor failures.
Upper bounds are empirical and can miss under distribution shift.
Torque advice does not change recorded temperatures.
